lines.ruling: Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. Losses or deductions suspended in an earlier year by another provision and allowed this year (i8995 p. 3) are refused through qbi.unsupported (qbi.suspended), whose refusal on qbi.eligible reaches Form 8995 line 15; the one exception, a section 179 carryover from 2018 or later, is deducted on the return's only Schedule C (s179.carryover) and so enters line 2 instead of line 3, which gives the same line 4 and line 16 (line 4 combines lines 2 and 3). Within scope line 3 is the latest form's line 16 (or Schedule C (Form 8995-A) line 6) carryforward, taken as printed (owner ruling 1a); an unreported earlier loss is refused by qbi.unreported_loss.
